subject: Demo + proposed 2-week pilot: scope, success criteria, owners
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@orbishealth.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@orbishealth.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — quick next steps re: 2-week pilot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the model conversational flow looked promising for our triage use case. Quick notes from our side and what we need to move forward:

- We're interested in a short 2-week pilot to validate accuracy against our historical conversations and measure latency under representative traffic.
- Primary success criteria for us will be: intent classification >= 88% on the test set, entity extraction F1 >= 0.80, and p95 inference latency < 350ms when integrated behind our API gateway.
- Data: we can provide a 10k-message dataset sanitized of PHI for evaluation, plus a small live webhook for integration.
- Procurement: our security and procurement teams will need SOC2 evidence and a one-page data retention statement from Redwood. Procurement target is to sign trial MSA within 7 business days.

Could you send a short pilot plan (scope, owners, timeline) and the SOC2 summary so we can circulate internally? Also please flag any blockers you see.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Product, Orbis Health

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Thanks — quick next steps re: 2-week pilot

Hi Elena — great to meet you and the team today. Appreciate the clarity on success criteria. Below is a concise pilot proposal so you can share with procurement/security.

Proposed 2-week pilot (summary)
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference quality and latency for Orbis triage flows and measure end-to-end cost per 1k requests.
- Deliverables:
  1) Week 1: sandbox integration + bulk run on the 10k sanitized dataset. Deliver model scorecard and error analysis.
  2) Week 2: live webhook test with 500 requests/day for 3 days (traffic window) + final scorecard and suggested production config.
- Success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints):
  • Intent accuracy >= 88% on holdout set (measured by your test labels).
  • Entity extraction F1 >= 0.80.
  • p95 inference latency < 350ms from your gateway to response (we'll provide a small script for measurement).
  • No retained PHI in our logs — agree to a 30-day KV-cache retention default for the pilot, configurable.
- Roles/owners:
  • Redwood: Priyom Das (owner — technical lead + kickoff), Ben Carter (solutions/ops, on-call during integration), Marissa Cole (CS, success metrics & adoption recap).
  • Orbis: Elena Torres (product owner), Samir Patel (security/compliance), Michael Lopez (platform/infra).
- Timeline (target) — assumes data access and signed trial MSA:
  • Day 0: kick-off and sandbox creds exchanged.
  • Days 1–3: integration + sample calls.
  • Days 4–7: bulk run + initial scorecard.
  • Days 8–11: live webhook window and follow-ups.
  • Day 12–14: final report and handoff recommendations.

Attachments sent: poc-outline.pdf (pilot tasks & checkpoints), trial-msa-draft.docx (standard trial MSA). Also attaching a short SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) per your request.

Next steps for Orbis (requested):
1) Confirm the sanitized 10k dataset delivery method (S3 link or Drive shared folder).
2) Confirm Samir is the security reviewer and share any specific questionnaire items.
3) Approve the proposed kickoff date — we can start as early as Mon May 31 if MSA is signed by EOD May 28.

Please see the short pilot plan attached — happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk through if that's easier.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0124
[attachment: poc-outline.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

Hi Elena / Samir — quick responses inline and next steps below.

1) Data retention statement (pilot):
Redwood Inference will not persist customer-provided PHI beyond the agreed pilot retention window. For this pilot we will disable long-term KV persistence and limit runtime cache retention to 30 days; all logs containing customer request/response payloads will be redacted of fields marked as PHI prior to any temporary storage used for debugging. We will provide a signed addendum to the trial MSA to reflect this behavior.

2) Compliance artifacts & contact:
Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary report, redacted). Security lead to contact: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com). Ben will coordinate any additional questionnaire items with Samir.

3) Pilot cost:
The proposed 2-week pilot is complimentary (no pilot fee). Standard usage (API calls / token-based usage) will be tracked for measurement only; any unusually high runs (>5x expected traffic) will be discussed beforehand.

Next steps (to keep timeline tight):
- Samir: please send any specific security questionnaire items by EOD Thu May 27.
- Elena: confirm delivery method for the sanitized 10k dataset (S3 link preferred) and the kickoff availability for Mon May 31.
- Orbis: sign the trial MSA (DocuSign link below) so we can provision sandbox creds.
